args: test -f "$HOME/.config/envs/mqva-dokuwiki.sh" && source "$HOME/.config/envs/mqva-dokuwiki.sh" && exec npx -y mcp-remote https://w-mqv-atoms.qm.physik.uni-muenchen.de/lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php --header "Authorization: Bearer $DOKUWIKI_MCP_TOKEN"

d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/keynote-mcp"; test -d "$d" || { git clone -q https://github.com/easychen/keynote-mcp "$d" && git -C "$d" checkout -q 73780c4e80e9d1d465a9d4535b483704dd7ca39d; } || exit 1; cd "$d" && exec uv run --no-project --python "$HOME/.local/share/virtualenvs/py313/bin/python" --with-requirements requirements.txt --with 'mcp<2' python -c 'import asyncio, sys; out = sys.stdout; sys.stdout = sys.stderr; from src.server import KeynoteMCPServer; s = KeynoteMCPServer(); sys.stdout = out; asyncio.run(s.run())'

test -f "$HOME/.config/envs/knuspr.sh" && source "$HOME/.config/envs/knuspr.sh" && RHL_EMAIL=$(op read "$RHL_EMAIL") && RHL_PASS=$(op read "$RHL_PASS") && exec npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.knuspr.de/mcp --header "rhl-email: $RHL_EMAIL" --header "rhl-pass: $RHL_PASS"
